items.title: Apple rescues Hide My Email feature from the privacy scrap heap
items.content: Apple says it will no longer ditch using its icloud.com domain for hiding people's email addresses.

items.title: Apple debuts its ‘most powerful chip ever’ in M5 Ultra and M6
items.content: Apple unveils these new processors alongside an updated Mac Mini and Mac Studio.

items.title: Apple’s latest Mac Mini runs on a new M6 chip, and starts at $899
items.content: The base model of the Mac Mini comes with 256GB of storage, 16GB of RAM, and costs $899.

items.title: Hyperscalers might regret embracing natural gas if new forecast proves correct
items.content: Natural gas prices could triple in some parts of the U.S., which could saddle hyperscalers with massive bills to power their AI data centers.

items.title: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
items.content: Microsoft is simplifying Copilot by combining its consumer and business apps, and dropping AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research, and its Mico character.

items.title: After Microsoft threatened legal action, a security researcher publishes a new Windows zero-day bug
items.content: This is the latest zero-day released by security researcher Nightmare Eclipse, despite Microsoft publicly threatening to take legal action against them.

items.title: Benjamin Rosen, Who Brought Venture Capital to Tech, Dies at 93
items.content: An advocate for Apple on Wall Street, he was also a founding investor in early personal computing firms like Lotus and Compaq, where he served as chairman.

items.title: Dollar Tree and Dollar General Report Sales Gains as Shoppers Cut Costs
items.content: Dollar General and Dollar Tree each reported gains in sales and store traffic on Thursday as higher gas prices forced shoppers to pare back.

items.title: How SSENSE, a Canadian Retailer, Is Grappling With Trump’s Tariffs
items.content: Ssense’s comeback efforts include moving a core part of its business to the United States so American customers can avoid hefty tariffs.

items.title: “Anxious Generation” Author Jonathan Haidt on the Meta Settlement
items.content: In “The Anxious Generation,” he laid out the evils of social media for kids. The landmark Meta settlement seems to agree.
